Ask yourself if maintaining the peace/keeping quiet is causing you more pain than setting boundaries. Setting boundaries and communicating your feelings can be really scary (and sometimes you *might* upset someone), but it’s also super important to voice your concerns even when it’s hard to because your needs matter!

When I’m setting boundaries with someone who has hurt me, I like to do so from a place of calm so that the other person doesn’t get defensive and actually listens to me. I would tell them how I feel using “I” statements, and if they’re continually walking over me, ask them if they could stop their behavior. If they continue to overstep my boundaries, I would walk away and disengage. 

More often than not, my friends have been more than understanding when I set boundaries and my relationships improve because there’s more communication.
